resources.string: Keeps the display at full refresh rate when a floating picture-in-picture camera window would cap it at 60 Hz.
Floating windows no longer set a refresh-rate limit for the whole display. Full-screen camera apps keep the stock camera cap. Applies immediately.

Android caps the display at 60 Hz while an app uses the camera, to avoid dropped camera frames. This removes the cap for every app, including full-screen camera apps. Applies the next time an app turns its camera on.
